description: Fix mobile layout issues in the Coding/Leaderboard section and the AchievementsForm. These components have layout-collapse, overflow, and touch-target issues that affect the two most data-heavy pages. Independent of FEAT-001 (different files).
steps:
Read client/src/components/AchievementsForm/AchievementsForm.jsx. (a) `
` wrapper: add `overflow-hidden w-full` to existing classes. (b) Image preview ``: change `h-56 w-56 md:h-72 md:w-72` → `h-52 w-52 sm:h-64 sm:w-64 md:h-72 md:w-72 max-w-full`. (c) Form side div `md:w-2/3`: add `px-2 w-full`. (d) Submit `

Read client/src/components/coding/NoticeBar.jsx. Change `mx-4 flex w-fit items-center` → `flex w-full sm:w-fit items-center mx-0 sm:mx-auto`. Change `w-[90%] text-xs text-zinc-200 md:w-full md:text-sm` → `flex-1 text-xs text-zinc-200 sm:text-sm`.

Read client/src/components/coding/SortedTable.jsx. In the pagination section, find `<div className="flex items-center gap-1">` (the First/Prev/[page]/Next row) and add `flex-wrap` to it: `<div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">`. This prevents button clipping on very narrow viewports.

Read client/src/components/coding/LeaderboardPodium.jsx. In the header row `<div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-white/[0.07] mb-5">`, add `flex-wrap gap-2` so platform badge wraps below heading on narrow viewports.

Read client/src/components/coding/RatingLegend.jsx. (a) Toggle button: add `min-h-[44px]` to the `<button>` classes (currently `w-full flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-2.5 ...`; change `py-2.5` to `py-3 min-h-[44px]`). (b) Individual tier badges in the grid: add `text-[10px] sm:text-[11px]` to the badge `<div>` instead of fixed `text-[11px]`; add `text-center break-words hyphens-auto`.

Read client/src/components/coding/FilterSection.jsx. In the action buttons container `<div className="mt-5 flex items-center justify-end gap-3 border-t border-zinc-800/70 pt-4">`, add `flex-wrap` and change `justify-end` to `justify-end`. Also change both buttons to add `w-full sm:w-auto` so they fill the row on mobile: Clear button gets `w-full sm:w-auto`, Apply button gets `w-full sm:w-auto`.

Read client/src/components/coding/BarChart.jsx. Change the wrapper `<div className="mb-10 flex justify-center p-5">` to `<div className="mb-10 flex justify-center p-2 sm:p-5 w-full overflow-x-auto">`.
